set.body:
Acceptance criteria
- output origin plus destination index plus stencil offset is computed in checked Long arithmetic.
- Reflect and mirror periods are computed without Int overflow.
- Narrowing to Int occurs only after border mapping proves the coordinate is in range.
- Empty source spatial extents fail during plan preparation.
- Boundary tests cover large origins, extreme offsets, zero extents, reflection periods, and negative coordinates without large allocations.
- Direct, reference, and prepared executors share the checked logic.
set.title: Use checked stencil coordinate and border arithmetic
